main_text.p: bit, & addit exhortationes efficaces ad studium boni & odiū mali. Isa.1.16. Lauate uos, mūdi estote, remouete malum operum uestrorum a conspectu oculorū meorum: definite malefacere, 17.discite benefacere, quærite iudicium, dirigite oppressum, iudicate pupillo, iudicate viduæ. Tertiò, promissione veniæ & mitigationis malorum. Isa.59.1. Ecce nō est abbreuiata manus Iehouæ, ut saluare nō possit: nec aggrauata est auris eius, ut nō exaudiat. Ier.4.1, Si reuerfus fueris Israel, dixit Iehouah, ad me, & si abstuleris abominationes tuas a facie mea, non demigrabis. Postremò, feria comminatione. Luc.13,3.& 5. Nisi resipiscatis, omnes itidem peribitis.
Fuit autem Ionas poenitentiæ totius præco fidelis, ut ex historia de prædicatione & eius fructu liquet. Resipuerunt enim Niniuitæ ad præconium Ionæ.Lu-cæ 11.32.
Itaq; non est exiftimandum, minis folummodò egiffe, & mutilo poenitentiæ præconio contentum fuiffe: sed potius summa fide illa quatuor ἀφορμὰς[?] seu capita tradidiffe & urfiffe.

page.notes: The Greek word after "quatuor" is faint and only a best reading (marked [?]). "urfiffe" is doubtful and may be "urgiffe" or similar; left as read. The line-end hyphen in "Lu-cæ" is printed and kept. The word "oppressum" is split across a line end without a printed hyphen, so it is written whole. Printed spelling "Refipuerunt" and "solummodo" variants were copied as seen where legible. No marginal notes, signature or other furniture visible.
